version.description: Required top-level protocol version. Always return the literal string "1.0" as a sibling of action, never as an item inside tool_calls or delegations.

action.description: Selects the field that is active in this response. Use tool_call only with at least one tool_calls item, delegate only with at least one delegations item, and final only with a non-null response containing the actual result. This is the operation being returned now, not a future intention.

id.description: Required non-empty id, unique within this action and used by depends_on references.

name.description: Required exact name of one tool offered in this request.

arguments.description: Required JSON-encoded string whose decoded value is exactly one object containing only parameters declared by the selected tool, for example {"path":"IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md"}. Do not append prose, a tool result, or a second object.

depends_on.description: Required array of earlier call ids this call truly needs. Use [] for no dependencies; every named id must exist in the same action and cycles are invalid.

tool_calls.description: For action=tool_call this must be a non-empty array of calls to execute now. For action=delegate or final it must be null; never use an empty array.

id.description: Required non-empty id, unique within this delegation graph.

agent.description: Registered agent profile name, or null only when persona defines an ad-hoc agent.

persona.description: Registered persona name for an ad-hoc agent, or null when agent names a profile.

skills.description: Skill names for an ad-hoc agent; null when using a registered agent profile.

tools.description: Allowed tool names for an ad-hoc agent; null when using a registered agent profile.

task.description: Required self-contained task describing the result the child must produce.

depends_on.description: Required array of delegation ids that must finish first. Use [] when independent; every id must exist in this same delegation graph.

delegations.description: For action=delegate this must be a non-empty array of sub-agents to start now. For action=tool_call or final it must be null; never use an empty array.

type.description: Rendering type for the final content.

content.description: Required non-empty final answer content, not a statement of a future operation.

response.description: For action=final this must be a non-null object with the actual user-facing result. For tool_call or delegate it must be null. A plan to call a tool is not a final response.

data.description: Optional final structured result encoded as JSON text; null for tool_call and delegate.

error.description: Optional failure details for action=final only; otherwise null. Set only when the objective actually failed.

tools.description: Tools you actually used to reach this answer.

performed.description: Optional verified-work claim for action=final only; null for tool_call and delegate. List only operations confirmed by runtime results.

schema.description: Exactly one complete agent action. The action selects one and only one active field: tool_call => non-empty tool_calls and delegations/response/data/error/performed null; delegate => non-empty delegations and tool_calls/response/data/error/performed null; final => response object and tool_calls/delegations null. Never describe a future operation in data or response; select tool_call or delegate so the runtime can execute it.
